annotations.title: Structural worry: how urgent, and safe first steps

description: First-response triage when a customer reports a crack, a bulging or leaning wall, a sagging or fallen ceiling, a collapse, storm damage to a roof or chimney, a fallen tree or vehicle impact, a sagging floor, problems after a wall was removed, or signs of subsidence. Cautious by design: any danger to people makes it an emergency. Returns `urgency` (emergency, soon or routine: the same three speeds Nero Work uses), reasons, `safe_first_steps`, who to call now (999, gas 0800 111 999, power 105, the council dangerous structures team, insurer, structural engineer), and the questions to ask if details are missing. Example: a ceiling bulging with water under a bathroom: {"problem":"ceiling_sagging_or_fallen","water_coming_in":true}.

near_road_or_footway.description: Could it fall onto a road, footway or neighbour's property?

new_cracks_or_sagging_above.description: After a wall was removed or an impact: new cracks or sagging above?

trade.description: Optional. The builder's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill the contractor details in notices and CDM answers and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Site Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Oakline Building Services".

licence_body.description: Trade body or competent person scheme the business is a member of (the one used for the reference).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.
